must_contain: ABDM-1056 means either the care context you tried to link is already linked to the patient's ABHA, or the link reference number in your request does not match anything the gateway knows
if the care context is already linked, treat it as success after verifying by discovery that the care context is present, and do not retry the link
if the reference number is invalid, restart the link flow to obtain a fresh reference rather than guessing at the value
notes: named-only form: the reader gives just the code, no body pasted or attached.
